author: madremiawillyxd
body:
I got banned with the account realbarneynofake (now madremiawillyxd) and i got banned for 1 week because i was doing combat log and being a stupid with the mods and other people, i evaded the ban like 4 times and i am so sorry for that, when i evaded with otatopderomra (now otita) i msged a mod and i told him what that was my alt, "This is my alt ban me in this account" and i got banned for ban evasion forever, i was so stupid, i evaded with nkzombie, g0n2o and i tried to evade with "VOVESPONHA" yesterday but just to explain the mods by msg, i didn't do that because that is the account of a friend and feel bad because i just wanna play in avicus because i really love this server, i don't know why i did combat log or the other things, i don't think i am gonna get unbanned but you need to know that i feel bad for doing that, that was a really bad decision. sorry for bad english. 





sorry.
